name: round-2291
title: Fix round #2291 (2026-10-17, round 2) — batch on main + PRs #2297, #2299, #2298

cases.title: Two concentric circles with one radius are refused, one given per line (#2263, refusal)
lines: שני מעגלים בעלי מרכז משותף O ברדיוס 5
cases.lookFor: Nothing drawn; the message «בכל שורה נתון אחד — … נסו להקליד אותם בשני שלבים: (1) שני מעגלים בעלי מרכז משותף O  (2) ברדיוס 5».
cases.before: Two concentric circles drawn green, the AI having given 5 to the outer circle.

cases.title: Two contained circles with one radius get the same refusal (#2263, refusal)
cases.lookFor: Refused with the same message; parts (1) «שני מעגלים מוכלים» (2) «ברדיוס 5».
cases.before: Sent to the AI, which drew the 5 on a circle of its choosing.

cases.title: Two internally tangent circles with one radius get the same refusal (#2263, refusal)
cases.lookFor: Refused with the same message; parts (1) «שני מעגלים משיקים מבפנים» (2) «ברדיוס 5».

cases.title: The two-line form still builds (guard)
lines: שני מעגלים בעלי מרכז משותף O
cases.lookFor: Two concentric circles, both lines green; the outer circle has radius 10, the inner one is smaller.

cases.title: The catalog sentence works on two drawn circles (#2209)
cases.lookFor: The circles touch at M, green. Known defect (#2303, needs your ruling): the line also shows a false «ציירנו את שני הנתונים שכתבתם בשורה אחת…» tip; the fix is built and waits for your answer on #2303.

cases.title: Typing the tangency again adds nothing (#2209)
cases.lookFor: The last line answers «זה כבר קיים באיור — אין מה להוסיף.», and the touch point is still M.

cases.title: The reversed twin names the touch X (#2209)
lines: המעגלים P ו-O משיקים בנקודה X
cases.lookFor: Only X is drawn (no M), and there is no «נפלו על אותה נקודה» notice.
cases.before: Both M and X were drawn, with the notice.

cases.title: A later «מבפנים» makes the tangency internal (#2210, riskiest)
cases.lookFor: One circle inside the other, touching at M, green. Untick the last row: the circles go back to external.

cases.title: A containment makes a later tangency internal (#2210)
lines: מעגל P מוכל בתוך מעגל O
המעגלים O ו-P משיקים בנקודה X
cases.lookFor: P inside O, touching it at X, green.

cases.title: Two kinds that disagree are still flagged (control)
cases.lookFor: The last line gets «לא נמצאה תצורה שמקיימת את כל הדרישות יחד…» and the yellow «⚠ ייתכן שהאיור אינו תואם למה שתיארתם: המעגלים O ו-P צריכים להיות משיקים…» panel.

cases.title: A typed height to the base keeps the apex (#1839)
cases.lookFor: Press «הציגו תצורה אחרת» several times: A stays the apex (AB = AC) and D stays on BC in every view.
cases.before: The apex moved to B and then C, and D was drawn on a leg.

cases.title: A typed altitude to a leg never lands on the base (#1839)
cases.lookFor: Press «הציגו תצורה אחרת» several times: the apex alternates between A and C only, never B, and E stays on line AC.
cases.before: One view put the apex at B, making AC the base.

cases.title: An apex-angle bisector, then an equality, gives the equilateral triangle (#1839)
cases.lookFor: After the second line A stays the apex on every press; after «AB = BC» the triangle is equilateral and every row is green.
cases.before: The apex cycled with the bisector line, and «AB = BC» moved the apex to B.

cases.title: A typed vertex that is not the apex becomes the apex (beyond the plan)
cases.lookFor: B becomes the apex and D lies on AC.

cases.title: The isosceles triangle with base 8 is drawn on every run (#1857)
cases.lookFor: Accepted: AB = 4, AC = 8, BC = 8, every row green. On a first (cold) load expect a wait of about 4 seconds.
cases.before: On a cold or slow run «BC = 8» was refused «… סותר את «משולש שווה שוקיים ABC» … וקו ישר אינו משולש»; on a warm run it committed.

cases.title: The base-9 twin still builds (guard)
cases.lookFor: Accepted, drawn as 4·9·9, every row green (a cold run takes about 6 seconds).

cases.title: An angle written with π is refused and degrees are taught (#1837, refusal)
cases.lookFor: Refused at once, with no AI spinner and nothing drawn: «בגאומטריה של המישור זוויות נכתבות במעלות — למשל ∠ABC = 90».
cases.before: The line went to the AI.

cases.title: «pi» in Latin letters no longer draws a 2° angle (#1837, refusal)
cases.lookFor: The same refusal; the triangle is unchanged.
cases.before: A 2° angle was drawn with a green ✓.

cases.title: Rectangle, rhombus, then square: the square line says it is already there (#2193)
cases.lookFor: The third line answers «זה כבר קיים באיור — אין מה להוסיף.» and no row is added.
cases.before: «C כבר מוגדרת ולא ניתן להגדיר אותה מחדש כמשהו אחר…».

cases.title: Parallelogram, kite, then rhombus: the same answer (#2193)
cases.lookFor: «זה כבר קיים באיור — אין מה להוסיף.», no new row.

cases.title: A side given with the square after the merge is applied (#2193)
cases.lookFor: The line commits and the square's side is 5.
cases.before: Refused with the engine text naming C; the 5 was lost.

cases.title: 3-D refuses an angle written with π (#1837, refusal)
cases.lookFor: Refused with the same degrees sentence; no angle mark labelled π.
cases.before: An angle mark labelled «π» was recorded.

cases.title: A length on each of two triangles (#1855)
cases.lookFor: Every row green, with 5 and 2 drawn on their segments.
cases.before: «AB = 5» was refused «הנתונים סותרים זה את זה…».

cases.title: Two triangles stated parallel (#1855)
cases.lookFor: Green, and AB is visibly parallel to DE.

cases.title: A second triangle gets its own size and tilt (beyond 2-D)
cases.lookFor: Press «הציגו תצורה אחרת» several times: DEF's size and angle relative to ABC change, and it is drawn slightly tilted off the floor.
cases.before: Always the same size and parallel.

cases.title: A quadrilateral over a free point is flat (#1935, riskiest)
cases.lookFor: D moves into ABC's plane when the third line is added, the quadrilateral is flat when you orbit, and A, B, C do not move. At many seeds it may be drawn crossed (a bow-tie): that is #2300, filed.

cases.title: A rectangle over the triangle (#1935)
cases.lookFor: A flat rectangle, green.

cases.title: A quadrilateral not in one plane is still refused (guard)
cases.lookFor: The last line is refused: «מרובע הוא צורה שטוחה, והקודקודים A, B, C, D אינם נמצאים במישור אחד…».

cases.title: A flat pyramid is refused, naming why (#1860, refusal)
cases.lookFor: The third line is refused: «לא ניתן: «∠DAS = 50» יחד עם «∠BAS = 40» מתקיימים רק אם הפירמידה SABCD שטוחה — וגוף שטוח אינו פירמידה.» The pyramid stays 3-D.
cases.before: A flat pyramid was drawn with the blue notice «הנתונים שרשמתם מכריחים את … להיות שטוח…».

cases.title: Lengths that put the apex in the base say why (#1860, refusal)
cases.lookFor: «לא ניתן: «SA = 5» יחד עם «AB = 6», «BC = 8» מתקיימים רק אם הפירמידה SABCD שטוחה — וגוף שטוח אינו פירמידה.»
cases.before: The generic «הנתונים סותרים זה את זה — אין גוף שמקיים את…».

cases.title: A thin but real pyramid still builds (guard)
cases.lookFor: All three lines accepted, no notice and no error.

cases.title: A second, different length is refused, naming the first (#2105, refusal)
cases.expectRefusal: אי אפשר לקיים את שניהם יחד
cases.lookFor: «לא ניתן: «AB=5» סותר את «AB=4» — אי אפשר לקיים את שניהם יחד. הסיבה: |AB| = 5.»

cases.title: A second, different angle is refused, naming the first (#2105, refusal)
cases.expectRefusal: אי אפשר לקיים את שניהם יחד
cases.lookFor: «לא ניתן: «∠CBA=50» סותר את «∠ABC=40» — אי אפשר לקיים את שניהם יחד. הסיבה: ∠CBA = 50°.»

cases.title: The same letter with a different coefficient (guard)
cases.expectRefusal: אי אפשר לקיים את שניהם יחד
cases.lookFor: «לא ניתן: «AB=3a» סותר את «AB=2a» — … הסיבה: |AB| = 3a.», and the label is still «2a».

cases.title: A square's side, then a different side, names the square line (beyond 2-D's wording)
cases.lookFor: The refusal names «ריבוע ABCD שצלעו 4». (2-D says «סותר נתון קודם» here.)

cases.title: Analytic refuses an angle written with π (#1837, refusal)
cases.lookFor: Refused with the same degrees sentence; no 1.57° angle drawn.
cases.before: Drawn as a 1.57° angle with no warning.

cases.title: π as a length still works (guard)
cases.lookFor: AB is set to π (≈3.14) and the line is accepted.

cases.title: A circle through three fixed collinear points is refused even with a free point (#1963, refusal)
lines: מעגל שעובר דרך A, B ו-C
cases.lookFor: The last line is refused: «בשרטוט הזה מעגל לא קיים — הנתונים כבר קובעים את כל הנקודות…», the same message as without «נקודה Q».
cases.before: Every line recorded; the circle was named but drawn nowhere, with nothing said.

cases.title: A circle through A, D, B with D on AB is refused, naming «D על AB» (#1963, refusal)
lines: מעגל שעובר דרך A, D ו-B
cases.lookFor: «לא ניתן: «מעגל שעובר דרך A, D ו-B» סותר את «D על AB» — אי אפשר לקיים את שניהם יחד. הסיבה: A, D ו-B על ישר אחד, ואין מעגל שעובר דרך שלוש נקודות על ישר אחד.»
cases.before: Recorded green, drawn nowhere (with «D על הישר AB», a huge stray arc).

cases.title: A real circle is still accepted (control)
lines: מעגל שעובר דרך A, D ו-E
cases.lookFor: Recorded, and the circle is drawn.

cases.title: The exam's numbers become exact once a is given (#1818)
cases.lookFor: z₁ reads «z₁ = 1+i» (polar «z₁ = √2·cis45°»), z₂ reads «z₂ = 1-i»; the asks answer «1+i» and «√2»; the status says the figure is fully determined.
cases.before: «z₁ ≈ 1.41·cis45°», «|z1|» answered «≈ 1.41», and z₁, z₂ were counted as free.

cases.title: The student's answer a = −1 is checked as correct (#1818)
cases.lookFor: The claim is marked as holding.

cases.title: A wrong value of a is marked wrong (#1818)
cases.lookFor: The claim is marked as not holding (✗), and «מהו z1?» answers «56+46i».

cases.title: PR #2297 · A «הוכיחו כי» line is refused with an explanation (#1870, refusal)
cases.lookFor: «זו טענה להוכחה, לא נתון — הכלי משרטט את הנתונים ואינו בודק הוכחות. הקלידו רק את מה שנתון בשאלה: "הוכיחו כי |z1| = 5"»; only z1 stays in the list.

cases.title: PR #2297 · The exam's mixed line records nothing (refusal)
cases.lookFor: The same refusal, quoting only "הוכיחו כי |z1| = 5"; the list stays empty.

cases.title: PR #2297 · A bare statement is still checked (guard)
cases.lookFor: «w ממשי» records with ✓; «w מדומה טהור» records with ✗.

cases.title: PR #2299 · The median to the base is understood (#2018)
cases.lookFor: A segment from the apex to M, the midpoint of the base.

cases.title: PR #2299 · The median follows «הציגו תצורה אחרת» (#2018)
cases.lookFor: Each press moves the apex, and the median moves to the new base, never to a leg. The triangle does not jump when the second line is added.

cases.title: PR #2299 · The altitude to a leg, twice, takes both legs (#2018)
cases.lookFor: Two altitudes on two different legs, still so after pressing «הציגו תצורה אחרת».

cases.title: PR #2299 · A stated base pins the apex (#2018)
cases.lookFor: A median from A to the midpoint of BC; the apex stays at A after pressing «הציגו תצורה אחרת».

cases.title: PR #2299 · A plain triangle has no base (refusal)
cases.lookFor: Refused with «אין בסרטוט צלע יחידה שמתאימה ל"בסיס" — הצהירו קודם על המשולש המתאים …», nothing drawn.

cases.title: PR #2298 · Hide and dash a line (#2238)
cases.lookFor: Clicking the line opens a menu titled «l1» with «הסתירו קטע», «מקווקו» and the measure entries. «מקווקו» dashes it; «הסתירו קטע» leaves a faint ghost; clicking the ghost offers «הציגו קטע», which brings it back dashed.
cases.before: The click offered only the measure entries.

cases.title: PR #2298 · A circle can be hidden, not dashed (#2238)
cases.lookFor: Clicking the circle offers «הסתירו קטע» only. Hiding removes the circle and its centre cross; P₁ stays. Clicking where the outline was offers «הציגו קטע».

cases.title: PR #2298 · A parabola gets the line's menu (#2238)
cases.lookFor: «הסתירו קטע» and «מקווקו». «מקווקו» dashes it; one «בטל» makes it solid again.

cases.title: PR #2298 · A hidden circle stays hidden after a rename (#2238)
cases.lookFor: Click the circle and choose «הסתירו קטע», then type «שנה שם O ל-K»: the row reads «…שמרכזו K(2,3)…» and the circle is still hidden.
cases.before: New behaviour; nothing could be hidden.
